ordinary_cli_thread_scaling.interpretation: 3 fresh Go CLI processes per setting;12 warmup+10 measured Java compilations per setting; no workers or parsed-extern caches; Java/Go ratios; peakRSS process lifetimes documented in performance.md; whitespace Java2job half drift -8.7% limits fine-grained scaling interpretation

archive_notice.status: historical pre-integration measurements, not measurements of current main
archive_notice.measurement_difference: Recorded binaries included global AST node chunks and vendored Go1.24 Unicode tables. Current main uses direct node allocation and a compact Unicode delta wrapper; both rejected mechanisms and their license additions are absent from this PR.
